2026-11-10 slice: nine on-air setup tiles (pattern, minutes, warm-up, ambient, bell tone, interval, end bell) moved to choiceTileClasses and seven Journey v2 controls (drip, target and settings tiles, difficulty and format pills, pillar pill, official flag) to chipClasses or choiceTileClasses; raw-button-bg 162 to 146. Idle tiles gain the kit's bg-surface and selected pills the kit's solid-ink chip, by design. About 146 sites remain, mostly admin (28) and bespoke controls whose bg-primary-bg tint matches the lexical counter; the row stays open.

2026-11-10 slice 3: the Space branding form's seven selectable tiles (logo backdrop, hero height, button orientation, scrim, look, theme, soon-state theme) moved to choiceTileClasses; raw-button-bg 146 to 139. Active tiles are disabled, so each keeps disabled:opacity-100 over the kit's disabled dimming. About 139 sites remain.

2026-11-11 slice 4: practice builder Focus, Effort and timer-kind tiles and the join induction's option tiles (two feature tiles and one answer tile) moved to choiceTileClasses; raw-button-bg 139 to 133. About 133 sites remain; the dense editor inspector controls (segmented bars, the 28x16 switch) are left on purpose because the kit Switch and chip change their size and fill.

2026-11-11 slice 5: event form attendance-mode and price-mode tiles moved to choiceTileClasses; the Library create studio type pill and the guest seat form option pill moved to chipClasses; raw-button-bg 133 to 129. The create studio's Quick/Rich engine switch is a segmented pair and stays. About 129 sites remain.

2026-11-11 slice 6: walkthrough editor icon tiles to choiceTileClasses; demo studio preset and channel pills and the dispatch composer type pills to chipClasses; raw-button-bg 129 to 124. About 124 sites remain.
